snippet.title: Spell Strike Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDiGI SIP18 trailer for Spell Strike game.

All Persephone wanted was to summon a friend, but instead she accidentally summoned a horde of demons! Shoot magic bolts into the demonic portals to close them and help her save the town. Don’t hit the portal in the same spot twice and be mindful of demon sabotage! Coming soon!

2018
